title: Weekly Release Notes: Aug 1-7, 2026 – Kojo
markdown:
[Skip to main content](https://support.usekojo.com/hc/en-us/articles/54206867976979-Weekly-Release-Notes-Aug-1-7-2026#main-content)

## Features and Enhancements for Warehouse & Inventory

### Tool Inventory Permissions

**Available: August 2026 \| Generally Available**

Tool inventory permissions can now be managed by admins using our role-based permissions system, providing control over which roles can see and work with tools.

* * *

## Features and Enhancements for Catalog & Marketplace

### Catalog Manager Import Failure Visibility

**Available: August 2026 \| Generally Available**

Within Catalog Manager, the bulk import UI now surfaces failed deletions to the user, so you can see exactly what still needs attention.

* * *

## Features and Enhancements for Project Management

### Major PO Release Optionality

**Available: August 2026 \| Generally Available**

Major POs no longer have to use releases. On the PO Details tab, set the releases toggle to off and your Major PO can run without them.

* * *

_Have questions about any of these updates?_ Reach out directly to your CSM or [s _ubmit a request._](https://support.usekojo.com/hc/en-us/requests/new)
